comments.author: Hazardtyz
comments.body: What levels of enemies do you find in here?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: There are no enemies (or even a dungeon, for that matter) to be found inside the Knossos ruins. Or did you mean to ask about the NPC levels of the exterior land zone?

comments.author: Hazardtyz
comments.body: oh ok so theirs no enemies at all in here, was debating visiting to see what else i could find with search but was worried that when i got there id get my arse handed to me by some sort of high level NPC

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Understood. Although you'll often find a boss NPC and his minions standing around outside of "Ruins Interior" entryways, the interior zones themselves are safe havens -- no NPCs to be fought, and your fatigue rate stops increasing while inside, too.

comments.author: Hazardtyz
comments.body: Thanks for the heads up Guilder.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Hmm. Looks like there might be something special to see inside of the Knossos ruins, after all... one day. (Spoilers, obviously.)
